@Yves Jäckle, @Nicolas Alexander Weiss and I (Michael Rothgang) are organising an informal Lean learning workshop. We're starting with a one-day workshop at HU Berlin, on May 10 (9.30-17.00, with breaks in between); if there's interest we can extend this by

  • another one-day workshop
  • a regular meeting (such as, 2 hours a week like a standard seminar)
  • participants choose and working on their personal projects, with time together to discuss obstacles and possible solutions
  • or whatever else suits the group best.

No prior Lean knowledge is required (if you know Lean, you're also very welcome; I know some Lean and expect to learn a lot). Feel free to forward this to anybody who you think could be interested!

Further information and practical details can be found on my webpage: https://www2.mathematik.hu-berlin.de/~rothganm/BerLean.html

The workshop is in-person only, sorry. (If you're Berlin-based but cannot attend at that date/not in person, feel free to DM me and we can discuss further.)

@Michael Rothgang A year late, but did this...

  • a regular meeting (such as, 2 hours a week like a standard seminar)

ever take off?
The workshop happened, but didn't turn into a regular Lean meeting. (And by now, I'm not in Berlin any more.)
